# Text-to-Speech Installation Guide

## ✅ Recommended: Kokoro TTS

**Kokoro** is the best free, open-source ElevenLabs alternative for your use case:
- ✅ **100% Free** (Apache 2.0 license - commercial use allowed)
- ✅ **Lightweight** (82M parameters vs billions for other models)
- ✅ **CPU-capable** (doesn't require a powerful GPU)
- ✅ **14 built-in voices** (English, Japanese, Chinese, etc.)
- ✅ **Fast** (real-time speed on modern CPUs)
